Find the exact policy statement on disclosure of data or details beyond the abstract text.'}':
- All abstracts accepted to ACR Convergence are under media embargo once presenters are notified of acceptance. They may be presented at other meetings or published as manuscripts after notification but not discussed in non-scholarly venues/outlets.
- Accepted abstracts are made public online in advance of the meeting and published in an online supplement of *Arthritis & Rheumatology*. Information in those abstracts may not be released until they appear online.
- Exception: Academic institutions, private organizations, and companies with products whose value may be influenced by abstract info may issue a press release coinciding with abstract availability on the ACR website.
- Exact policy statement on disclosure of data/details beyond the abstract text:
  "However, the ACR continues to require that information that goes beyond that contained in the abstract (e.g., discussion of the abstract done as part of editorial news coverage) is under media embargo until **10:00 AM ET on November 7**. Journalists with access to embargoed information cannot release articles or editorial news coverage before this time."
- Editorial news coverage = original articles/videos by employed journalists reporting facts, commentary, and expert quotes using various sources.
- Violation may result in abstract withdrawal and other measures. Authors must notify all stakeholders of the policy.
- Questions: contact abstracts@rheumatology.org.

- Editorial news coverage = original articles/videos by employed journalists reporting facts, commentary, and expert quotes using various sources.
- Violation may result in abstract withdrawal and other measures. Authors must notify all stakeholders of the policy.
